16408-the-grey-wig-stories-and-novelette.creator: I. Zangwill
16408-the-grey-wig-stories-and-novelette.description: A book by I. Zangwill. rn to Madame la Propriétaire, with her buxom bookkeeper of a daughter and her tame baggage-bearing husband. This full-blooded, jovial creature, with her swart moustache, represented the only Parisian success of three provincial lives, and, in her good-nature, had permitted her decayed townswomen--at as low a rent as was compatible with prudence--to shelter themselves under her roof and as near it as possible.

arxiv-2012-04727.title: Nonlinearity accelerates the thermalization of the quartic FPUT model with stochastic baths
arxiv-2012-04727.creator: Stefano Ruffo
arxiv-2012-04727.description: Abstract We investigate the equilibration process of the strongly coupled quartic Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou (FPUT) model by adding Langevin baths to the ends of the chain. The time evolution of the system is investigated by means of extensive numerical simulations and shown to match the results expected from equilibrium statistical mechanics in the time-asymptotic limit.

arxiv-2101-01233.title: Perelman’s entropy on ancient Ricci flows
arxiv-2101-01233.creator: Zilu Ma, Yongjia Zhang
arxiv-2101-01233.description: Abstract In [ ZY2 ] , the second author proved Perelman’s assertion, namely, for an ancient Ricci flow with bounded and nonnegative curvature operator, bounded entropy is equivalent to noncollapsing on all scales. In this paper, we continue this discussion.

arxiv-2202-07705.title: Analysis of the robustness and dynamics of spin-locking preparations for the detection of oscillatory magnetic fields
arxiv-2202-07705.creator: Milena Capiglioni, Federico Turco, Roland Wiest, Claus Kiefer
arxiv-2202-07705.description: Abstract Extracting quantitative information of neuronal signals by non-invasive imaging is an outstanding challenge for understanding brain function and pathology. However, state-of-the-art techniques offer low sensitivity to deep electrical sources. Stimulus induced rotary saturation (SIRS) is a recently proposed magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) sequence that detects oscillatory magnetic fields using a spin-lock preparation.

arxiv-2203-01795.title: Force density functional theory in- and out-of-equilibrium
arxiv-2203-01795.creator: Salomée M. Tschopp, Florian Sammüller, Sophie Hermann, Matthias Schmidt, Joseph M. Brader
arxiv-2203-01795.description: Abstract When a fluid is subject to an external field, as is the case near an interface or under spatial confinement, then the density becomes spatially inhomogeneous. Although the one-body density provides much useful information, a higher level of resolution is provided by the two-body correlations.

arxiv-2302-13370.title: A comprehensive model of morphologically realistic Cosmic Dust particles: an application to mimic the unusual Polarization properties of the interstellar Comet 2I/Borisov
arxiv-2302-13370.creator: Prithish Halder, Sujan Sengupta
arxiv-2302-13370.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Prithish Halder, Sujan Sengupta. The cosmic dust particles found in space are mainly porous aggregates of smaller grains. Theoretically, these aggregates are replicated using fractal geometry, assuming a cluster of spheres. Although, the light scattering response of cosmic dust aggregates has been thoroughly studied using clusters of spherical grains in the past few decades, yet, the effect of irregularities on the surface of each grain in an entire aggregate has mostly been neglected.

arxiv-2312-05855.title: NeVRF: Neural Video-based Radiance Fields for Long-duration Sequences
arxiv-2312-05855.creator: Minye Wu Tinne Tuytelaars
arxiv-2312-05855.description: Abstract Adopting Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) to long-duration dynamic sequences has been challenging. Existing methods struggle to balance between quality and storage size and encounter difficulties with complex scene changes such as topological changes and large motions. To tackle these issues, we propose a novel neural video-based radiance fields (NeVRF) representation.

arxiv-2410-05689.title: Diffractive photoproduction of dark photons
arxiv-2410-05689.creator: J. Cepila, J. G. Contreras
arxiv-2410-05689.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by J. Cepila, J. G. Contreras. Dark photons serve as a portal to connect the dark and standard model sectors. Here, we propose photon-induced exclusive diffractive processes as a new tool to study the production of dark photons in current and future colliders. These processes join the strength of the strong force, yielding large cross sections, with the cleanliness of diffractive photoproduction, providing a clean experimental environment.

arxiv-2505-01448.title: OpenAVS: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Audio Visual Segmentation with Foundational Models CCS: Computing methodologies Video segmentation CCS: Computing methodologies Information extraction
arxiv-2505-01448.creator: Shengkai Chen, Yifang Yin, Jinming Cao, Shili Xiang, Zhenguang Liu, Roger Zimmermann
arxiv-2505-01448.description: Abstract . Audio-visual segmentation aims to separate sounding objects from videos by predicting pixel-level masks based on audio signals. Existing methods primarily concentrate on closed-set scenarios and direct audio-visual alignment and fusion, which limits their capability to generalize to new, unseen situations.

arxiv-2505-05417.title: Evidence of chiral fermion edge modes through geometric engineering of thermal Hall in α \alpha -RuCl 3
arxiv-2505-05417.creator: Heda Zhang, Gábor B. Halász, Sujoy Ghosh, Stephen Jesse, Thomas Z. Ward, David Alan Tennant, Michael McGuire, Jiaqiang Yan
arxiv-2505-05417.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Heda Zhang, Gábor B. Halász, Sujoy Ghosh, Stephen Jesse, Thomas Z. Ward, David Alan Tennant, Michael McGuire, Jiaqiang Yan. The experimental observation of half-integer-quantized thermal Hall conductivity in the Kitaev candidate material α \alpha -RuCl 3 has served as smoking-gun signature of non-Abelian anyons through an associated chiral Majorana edge mode. However, both the reproducibility of the quantized thermal Hall conductivity and the fundamental nature of the associated heat carriers, whether bosonic or fermionic, are subjects of ongoing and vigorous debate.

pmc-10648786.creator: Anjan Debnath, Md Mahedi Hasan, M Raihan, Nadim Samrat, Mashael M Alsulami, Mehedi Masud, Anupam Kumar Bairagi, Anastasios Doulamis
pmc-10648786.description: The occurrence of tomato diseases has substantially reduced agricultural output and financial losses. The timely detection of diseases is crucial to effectively manage and mitigate the impact of episodes. Early illness detection can improve output, reduce chemical use, and boost a nation’s economy.

pmc-10675085.title: Hormonal Content and Gene Expression during Olive Fruit Growth and Ripening
pmc-10675085.creator: Maria C. Camarero, Beatriz Briegas, Jorge Corbacho, Juana Labrador, Maria C. Gomez-Jimenez
pmc-10675085.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The cultivated olive (Olea europaea L. europaea) is one of the most valuable fruit trees worldwide. However, the hormonal mechanisms underlying the fruit growth and ripening in olives remain largely uncharacterized. In this study, we investigated the physiological and hormonal changes, by ultra-high performance liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (UHPLC-MS), as well as the expression patterns of hormone-related genes, using quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) analysis, during fruit growth and ripening in two olive cultivars, ‘Arbequina’ and ‘Picual’, with contrasting fruit size and shape as

pmc-11993236.title: The Enhancement of Potato (Solanum Tuberosum L. Cv. Odyssey) Resistance to Bacterial Soft Rot Disease Through Transformation of the Glyphosate-Resistant Gene from Dickeya Dadanti
pmc-11993236.creator: Hossein Pasalari, Amir Roeintan, Sezai Ercisli, Danial Kahrizi, Chamran Hemmati
pmc-11993236.description: Objective: An efficient protocol was developed via the Agrobacterium-mediated transformation method with the plasmid, p485, harboring the aroA gene from the bacterial species Dickeya dadantii, to improve resistance to potato bacterial soft rot disease. The study aimed to investigate the relationship between glyphosate application and the enhancement of potatoes’ resistance to two bacterial pathogens affecting the plants.

pmc-12735897.title: Silver Nanowire-Amorphous Indium Zinc Oxide Composite Electrodes for Transparent Film Heaters
pmc-12735897.creator: Xingzhen Yan, Mengying Lyu, Ziyao Niu
pmc-12735897.description: Transparent conductive films based on silver nanowire meshes have demonstrated significant potential as alternatives to conventional tin-doped indium oxide and fluorine-doped tin oxide thin films. However, these materials feature high junction resistance, poor damp heat (DH) stability, and weak mechanical adhesion to substrates, which are critical issues that must be addressed before any practical applications.

pmc-13184803.title: Discrete blue and green light wavebands alter biomass, morphology, and color in lettuce (Lactuca sativa L.)
pmc-13184803.creator: Masaki Kurosaki, Christopher P. Levine, Neil S. Mattson
pmc-13184803.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Previous research demonstrated that blue (B) light decreased internode elongation and leaf surface area (LSA) while increasing anthocyanin concentration as the red (R) to B ratio decreased, but the effects of specific B wavebands on lettuce remain underexplored.

pmc-13255826.title: The Precision Paradox in Prostate Cancer Diagnostics: Grade Migration, Risk Misclassification, and Overtreatment in the mpMRI-Targeted Biopsy Era
pmc-13255826.creator: Andrea Micillo, Simone Steffani, Luca Orecchia, Roberto Miano, Eric Walser, Guglielmo Manenti
pmc-13255826.description: Simple SummaryModern prostate cancer (PCa) diagnosis increasingly relies on multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (mpMRI) and targeted biopsy (TBx) to sample the most suspicious areas of the prostate gland. While this has been shown to improve the detection of aggressive disease and minimize the diagnosis of indolent tumors, it can also introduce a bidirectional diagnostic tension.

Directors of class A and class B shall be chosen in the following manner: The Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System shall classify the member banks of the district into three.
